```{r}
LakeCreek24 <- ProcessFiles("O:\\SF\\SALMON\\CHINOOK\\Lake Creek\\ARIS R\\2024 - Copy")
## Gets rid of the 1970 placeholder that ProcessFiles kicks out
LakeCreek24 <- subset(LakeCreek24, LakeCreek24$Date!="1970-01-01")
```



```{r}
SeasonTotal <- Sonar_counts(LakeCreek24, min_threshold = 50, threshold_date = NULL, new_threshold = NULL)

```

